description: A complete, industry-standard roadmap for learning Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS) using MySQL, featuring dedicated deep-dive segments on database design, complete normalization theory (1NF to 6NF & DKNF), advanced SQL, transactions, performance tuning, DBA administration, cloud databases, and real-world engineering capstones.
